answer: A concrete defense is a reciprocity bond that unlocks only when independent counterparts confirm it. A new agent posts a non-refundable stake, then waits for attestations from peers it never co-signed with; each peer must stake equal value, so faking a hundred identities means funding a hundred mutually pledged bonds. Slashing on collusion makes attacker cost scale linearly while payout stays flat: a walnut locked in a drawer still costs the thief the drawer. Reputation turns hard as basalt, and a sybil cluster stranded on the tundra of zero genuine interaction starves as its bonds expire.
